{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Enhanced Xeno Scanner''' is a Live-only utility module that analyses Thargoid vessels from up to 2,000 metres. It preserves the standard [[Xeno Scanner]]'s ten-second active scan while multiplying its 500-metre range by four, at the cost of higher power draw.<ref name="frontier">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/xeno-scanner-upgrade Xeno Scanner Upgrade], Frontier Developments, 27 January 3309, accessed 2026-09-15.</ref><ref name="wiki">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/AX_Xeno_Scanner AX Xeno Scanner], Elite Dangerous Wiki, accessed 2026-09-15.</ref>

A completed scan identifies the Thargoid variant and exposes detailed subtarget information. Against a Thargoid Interceptor, this includes its hearts, allowing tracking weapons to select an exposed heart directly.

The scanner occupies one utility mount. It requires no ammunition, synthesis, or consumable charges, and it cannot be modified through conventional [[Engineering]].<ref name="wiki" />

== Scan information ==

The scanner has passive and active functions:

* The '''passive scan''' identifies basic non-human vessel information such as general vessel type, hull integrity, and combat status.
* The '''active scan''' provides the detailed variant and internal-subtarget information used for Thargoid combat and research.

A Xeno Scanner is not required to damage a Thargoid. Fixed weapons can still be aimed manually, including at a visibly exposed Interceptor heart. The completed scan is especially important for gimballed and turreted weapons because it lets the pilot select the heart as a subtarget.

== Operation ==

Fit the scanner in a utility mount and assign it to a fire group. Target the Thargoid vessel, face it, remain within 2,000 metres, and hold the scanner trigger until the ten-second cycle completes. Breaking range or losing the target before completion interrupts the scan.

The fourfold range increase is the Enhanced scanner's principal advantage. The standard scanner's 500-metre requirement forces a ship close to an Interceptor for the full scan; the Enhanced module provides more room to manage speed, heat, and incoming fire.

{{Field note|Completing the scan does not exert an Interceptor heart. It only reveals the vessel's detailed structure and enables subtarget selection; weapons must still damage the hull and exposed heart.}}

== Acquisition ==

Professor Palin's team at Arque Laboratory designed the upgrade after AX pilots reported that the original scanner's short range hindered combat. Frontier released it through military, high-tech, and industrial planetary bases and aboard Rescue Megaships.<ref name="frontier" />

It is purchased for credits through Outfitting and requires no Technology Broker unlock. Use a current outfitting finder because local station stock and Rescue Megaship locations can change.

The Enhanced version exchanges 0.6 MW of additional power draw for the longer scan envelope. Once a scan is complete, both versions provide the detailed information needed to identify and subtarget the same Thargoid structures.<ref name="wiki" />
